title: Generated AC1024 DIMASSOC detailed DWG writer control
scope: Bounded encoder and transport evidence for one locally authored AC1024 DIMASSOC object containing AcDbOsnapPointRef types 1, 6, and 13. The source DWG was written to /private/tmp and is not a repository fixture.

modeled_fields: main subentity type and GS marker
intersection object handle, subentity type, and GS marker
implementation.profile: AC1024 generated object, associativity flags 0x07; type 1 has two main handles; type 6 has one main and one intersection handle plus an intersection XREF path; type 13 has one main handle plus a main XREF path.
limitations: Generated referenced entity handles are intentionally not emitted, so the full-file probe verifies decoding and callback delivery, not reference-graph closure.
This generated vector does not establish native associative behavior or producer compatibility.

validation.encoder_failure_retry: An unsupported-detail encode is refused with body, string, and handle buffers empty; correcting the same source and retrying with those same buffers succeeds.

full_file_readback.read_observation: sourceVersion=16 (AC1024), entityParseFailures=0, objectParseFailures=0, callbacks=1, and all three authored types, ordered handle values, and both path strings were reported by the typed callback.
full_file_readback.reason: The harness correctly refuses to claim closure because the generated DIMENSION, main-reference, and intersection-reference target entities were not emitted.

libredwg_peer.path_free_control: The same generated profile with both path counts zero decoded types 1, 6, and 13 and all authored fields and handle values.
libredwg_peer.path_vector_observation: When XREF paths are present, LibreDWG reads the path count but reports a buffer overflow while reading the path string from the scalar cursor; subsequent ref decoding is lost.
libredwg_peer.source_explanation: In the local LibreDWG source, FIELD_T reads R2007+ text from str_dat (dec_macros.h:656-674), while FIELD_VECTOR_T invokes bit_read_T(dat) (dec_macros.h:1248-1274). DIMASSOC uses FIELD_VECTOR_T for both XREF path vectors (dwg2.spec:3689-3690, 3704-3705), explaining why this peer cannot qualify the path-bearing vector. This identifies a peer-reader limitation; it does not itself prove the writer interoperable.

validation.oda: ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0 was attempted locally; this invocation exited 134 with macOS PasteBoard/XPC connection errors, so no ODA conversion result is claimed.

adapterStrictOutputProbe.diagnostic: strict-complete conversion requires output qualification for every opaque DWG callback (qualified=2/3)
adapterStrictOutputProbe.interpretation: The generated DIMASSOC frame remains unqualified by the dwg2dxf adapter. This is fail-closed behavior; no DXF output was published. The next implementation slice is typed adapter retention, dimension/entity target closure, and exact source-frame output qualification.

support_effect: No producer, native semantic, graph-closure, or platform support claim is promoted. Keep broader DWG DIMASSOC qualification open until an independent implementation correctly reads the path vectors and the target graph is closed.
